digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate (G7 criteria routing and orchestrator)
propositions: G7 routing entry must transition from default_posture 'advisory' at 0.95 to 'blocking' at 0.85 threshold to enable plan-review blocking for high-validity divergent-implementation findings

G7 finding graded contradicts_reality or omits_required_site (floor kinds per ADR 0054) with validity >= 0.85 must block; incomplete_enumeration must remain advisory (impact 0.55 cannot reach 0.85 bar)
Unresolvable parent references must abstain-with-coverage (never emit as findings); closed parents checked against final state with sibling-handoff scope excluded from violations
Same-clause contradictions must emit at most one finding per contradicted parent clause, with additional manifestations folded into evidence (DEDUP-AT-SOURCE pattern)
Rubric guidance must restrict floor kinds to genuine contract contradictions or provably required omissions; cosmetic mismatches scoped to incomplete_enumeration (never auto-blocked)
Blocking-set test assertions and posture pin updated; criteria guide regenerated; FP classification re-run once >= 20 kind-graded findings accumulated (monitoring, not acceptance criterion)
